description: Cooking methods by cut. Temps are oven/pan settings; internal temps are USDA minimum (165F poultry) or quality targets from America's Test Kitchen style guidance. Times are approximate; always confirm with a thermometer.

methods.name: Sheet-pan roast
tips: Pat dry; do not crowd the pan
Skin side up on a rack or parchment for crisp skin
Use two pans for a batch; swap racks halfway

methods.name: Pan-sear then oven finish

cuts.thigh-bone-in-skin-on: Sear skin-down about 5 min, flip 5 min, then roast about 15 min to 175F

tips: Start skin-down in a cold or moderate pan to render fat
Best crisp skin, but not a batch method

methods.name: Air fryer
tips: Limited capacity, so it does not scale to weekly batch prep

methods.name: Slow cooker
tips: Breast overcooks easily; check at the low end

methods.name: Pressure cook and shred
tips: Fast way to make shreddable protein for burrito bowls

methods.name: Poach

cuts.breast-boneless-skinless: Cover with cold salted water, bring to a bare simmer, cover and turn off heat 15-18 min, or until 165F

tips: Gentle heat keeps lean breast juicy

methods.name: Braise

cuts.thigh-bone-in-skin-on: Brown, then simmer partly submerged 35-45 min

tips: Dark meat and tough cuts improve with longer cooking

cuts.breast-boneless-skinless: Pound to even thickness, 5-7 min per side
cuts.drumstick: Indirect heat first, then sear, 30-40 min

methods.name: Skillet crumble (ground meat)

cuts.ground-beef-90-10: Medium-high, 7-9 min; add a splash of water or broth
cuts.ground-turkey-93-7: Medium-high, 8-10 min; add oil or broth

tips: Leave undisturbed 1-2 min to brown before breaking up

cuts.egg-whole: Lower into boiling water 11-12 min, then ice bath; keeps 7 days refrigerated

methods.name: Sous vide

cuts.breast-boneless-skinless: 145F for 1.5-3 h (pasteurized), then sear or chill

tips: Only if you own a circulator

brine.quick: 1 tbsp kosher salt per cup water, 30-60 min for breasts and chops. Skip for thighs.
brine.dry: 1/2 tsp kosher salt per lb, refrigerated uncovered 1-24 h for crisper skin
